name: amazon-operator-intel-pp-cli
description: Private local-first Amazon operator control tower that joins Amazon Seller and Amazon Ads evidence into inventory, profitability, listing, and ad-spend decisions.

novel_features.name: War room
novel_features.description: Daily sales, profit, inventory, ad waste, listing, reimbursement, and top-action control tower.

novel_features.name: Restock or kill
novel_features.description: SKU decision queue for restock, conserve inventory, pause ads, liquidate, fix listing, or monitor.

novel_features.name: Ad spend guardrail
novel_features.description: Read-only guardrails for stockout spend, break-even ACOS, low-margin ads, no-sales waste, budget risk, and listing defects.

novel_features.name: SKU profit truth
novel_features.description: Contribution margin after ads, fees, returns, reimbursements, and COGS.

novel_features.name: Listing triage
novel_features.description: Listing defects ranked by business impact.

novel_features.name: Cash leaks
novel_features.description: Money-leak queue across ads, storage, stranded inventory, reimbursements, settlement gaps, returns, and low-margin SKUs.

novel_features.name: Search term actions
novel_features.description: Promote, negate, rank, competitor/product targeting, and dependency actions from Ads and Brand Analytics evidence.

novel_features.name: Operator plan
novel_features.description: One-week owner/delegate execution plan composed from scoring outputs.

novel_features.name: Cash calendar
novel_features.description: Cash pressure forecast from inventory, ad budgets, expected revenue, reimbursements, and storage/aging fees.

novel_features.name: Launch readiness
novel_features.description: Inventory, listing, ads, margin, keyword, review, and 14-day launch checklist.

novel_features.name: Rank defense
novel_features.description: Tradeoff recommendations for defending, reducing, or stopping paid search-term spend.

novel_features.name: Bundle opportunities
novel_features.description: Market-basket bundle/cross-sell/virtual-kit recommendations with rejection reasons.

novel_features.name: Vendor ops
novel_features.description: Local-file vendor readiness, deductions, PO watch, and scorecard workflows without Vendor Central API calls.

novel_features.name: Digest
novel_features.description: Owner-facing daily and weekly reports safe for empty datasets.
